name: Kilowallet
subtitle: XBT BLAKE2b wallet
creator: Kilombino
description: Kilowallet is a self-custodial iPhone wallet for XBT on the Bitcoin BLAKE2b proof-of-work chain. Created by Kilombino. This distribution is maintained by romanmodin. Create a wallet with 12 or 24 words, restore the first BIP-84 account (account 0) from 12, 15, 18, 21 or 24 English BIP-39 recovery words and an optional passphrase, or view a watch-only account. Recovery words are stored in the device Keychain and require device authentication to reveal or sign. Choose and approve a TLS Electrum server. The app relies on that server for balances and confirmation counts; it does not validate the complete highest-work chain. XBT uses the same address formats as Bitcoin SHA-256, so confirm the intended chain with the recipient. Keep an offline backup of your recovery words and passphrase. Anyone with that backup can control the wallet.
betaTestNotes: Use public test mnemonics or a disposable test wallet. Verify creation/restoration, authentication cancellation, background redaction, certificate rejection/approval, QR handling and exact-transaction recovery after network interruption. Real-funds sends require separate explicit authorization. Report device and iOS version with reproduction steps; never include recovery words, passphrases or private keys.
reviewNotes: Open source, Apache-2.0. Original creator Kilombino authorized release through the distribution owner. This app supports XBT on the BLAKE2b chain, not Bitcoin SHA-256 balances. No exchange, purchases or mining. No sign-in or backend account is required. Wallet signing uses unified sighash 0x21. Verify Apple organizational enrollment eligibility, export-compliance declaration and privacy answers before submission.
